widgets_values: 想系统学习comfyui实战教程的，可以到我的B站“阡陌电商设计”主页，课堂试看，也可点下面链接进去https://www.bilibili.com/cheese/play/ep1855828?csource=private_space_class_null&spm_id_from=333.1387.0.0

Please place the content here, remove the white area, and dress the character in the clothing that is within the white area. Meanwhile, the character's original position, posture, facial features, and hairstyle must remain unchanged, and the clothing should adapt to the character's body shape. The final result should be adaptive, have an automatic dimming function, be in 4K high definition, and feature excellent image quality.
